scope: All 21 resolved MED abstracts read; selected full-text/regulatory passages below. No full review of every manuscript or source number elsewhere in a retained owner is claimed.

items.review: Complete resolved abstracts; selected original HTML programme, model, tissue-attribution, microdissection and refinement passages in the first two papers. IM/MSL reassignment is by second-highest correlated centroid. No universal MSL-to-M mapping, functional HRD, drug dependency or clinical benefit follows from an expression label.

Complete resolved abstracts. Elloumi raw XML identity verified and selected paired-tissue results/figure-caption labels checked against the primary page. Classifier/risk output, incomplete receptor concordance and normal-admixture bias remain distinct. Parker full-text XML returned 500 and its web page a challenge; no Parker full-text review is claimed.

Complete resolved abstracts used at the stated cohort/analysis scope. Masuda has 146 profiled cases/130 with treated evaluable response; GeparSixto HRD measured in 193/315, with definition and non-significant treatment interaction retained. Molecular apocrine, claudin-low and independent Burstein labels are not invented children of a Lehmann profile.

Complete resolved abstracts and selected registry design/arms/endpoint/status modules. Fudan research IHC proxy and genomic cohorts are distinct from Lehmann or PAM50. The pooled randomised phase 2 package keeps population, comparator, cutoff, CI and harms. The first display of the raw MED text was re-read without tag-stripping to preserve p<0.0001 and the complete safety paragraph. The primary result is not a phase 3 OS or every-component claim.

Earlier conference and full 2024 analyses have different follow-up, HR and safety descriptions. Conference HR 0.38 is not substituted for the 2024 HR 0.44, and their safety analyses are not merged. No explanation for their differences is invented.

sources: NICE HTG719 recommendations 1.1-1.7 and test description 2.23-2.25
items.review: Exact raw openFDA identity verifies 6 September 2013 clearance. Selected original FDA decision PDF text is available through the primary parser; three direct PDF requests returned 404 and are not raw PDF captures. The NICE raw pages were read directly despite a separate web-parser 403. U.S. reporting/intended use, CE-marked product description and NHS conditions are different scopes; an original CE-marking year was not established. Low risk is not a direct chemotherapy-benefit estimate.
